notes.title: V1.01 available now. Bug fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]Fixed several common bugs reported by players.[/h1]

[h2]Notable bugs include:[/h2]
[list]
[*] removed softlock in 2-1
[*] removed softlock in 3-1
[*] fixed certain object casuing the player to start levitating
[*] removed soft lock in final level
[*] ajusted camera sensitivity to make it less sensitive
[/list]

Other smaller bugs fixed as well.

notes.title: Thank you all for such a cosy launch!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you so much to everyone who picked up the game today. I'm just one person making little games, and seeing people try it out — even just a few — truly means a lot.

If you’re enjoying it, a quick review helps the game reach more players. I’ll be watching for feedback and patching the game as and when things crop up!

Thanks again — Mochi and I really appreciate it.
